notes.title: The playtest version of "Maze and Fairy tale" will be released
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are extremely excited to announce that the playtest version of "Maze and Fairy Tale" is about to meet you on the Steam platform! Thanks to the unremitting efforts of the development team, this playtest version will be released from September to October 2024. This is an important step towards the official version of the game and an excellent opportunity for us to explore and improve the game together with the players.

In this version, we have carried out a large number of optimizations on the core gameplay, graphic performance, guidance prompts, monster AI, etc. of the game.

[b]In order to make players have a more compact experience in the playtest version, we have temporarily removed the maze exploration gameplay.
We will restore this gameplay in the demo version.[/b]

We have also planned to participate in the Steam New Product Festival in February 2025. We are looking forward to enabling more players to experience the unique charm of our game in this grand event.
For the players participating in the playtest version test, your feedback is crucial to us. Whether it is the game mechanism, graphics, sound effects or operation experience, any opinions and suggestions will help us make "Labyrinth Fairy Tales" more perfect.

Thank you all for your continuous attention and support. Let's start this game test journey together!

--------

HJ Game Studio
2024/09/10
